value.deck: Microsoft has released Visual Studio Code version 1.134, delivering new features and capabilities to the world's most popular code editor.
shortVersion: Microsoft has officially released Visual Studio Code version 1.134, continuing the application's rapid iteration cycle alongside broader updates across developer tools. Visual Studio Code, the world's most popular code editor—a software application used to write and manage program code—brings fresh capabilities and system improvements in this update.

Because every release affects millions of developers daily, these regular enhancements directly impact software workflows. For those who rely on these tools, version 1.134 delivers an updated workspace equipped with Microsoft's latest editor capabilities.
